original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚凯菲—拉菲亚—马库尔迪公路多收费站引争议，HURIWA要求暂停收费
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚人权作家协会（HURIWA）谴责政府在凯菲—拉菲亚—马库尔迪公路设置多个收费站，称该政策给纳萨拉瓦州和贝努埃州的贫困民众、商业运输业者及商户带来不公正的经济负担。该组织要求立即暂停收费，以待对政策、路况、收费站数量、缴费安排及收入管理透明度进行全面审查。政府自2025年2月4日起在227.2公里的阿布贾—凯菲—阿宽加—拉菲亚—马库尔迪公路开始收费，设四个主要收费点。HURIWA还质疑路况及无现金收费系统的实施问题。

location.site: 凯菲—拉菲亚—马库尔迪公路

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Human Rights Writers Association of Nigeria (HURIWA) has condemned the Nigerian Government’s imposition of multiple toll gates on the Keffi–Lafia–Makurdi highway

key_facts.fact: 该组织要求立即暂停收费以待全面审查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The group demanded the immediate suspension of toll collection along the corridor pending a comprehensive review of the policy

key_facts.fact: 政府自2025年2月4日起在227.2公里公路开始收费，设四个主要收费点
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigerian government commenced toll operations on February 4, 2025, along the 227.2-kilometre Abuja–Keffi–Akwanga–Lafia– Makurdi highway. The tolling arrangement covers four principal locations

key_facts.fact: 轿车每站收费500奈拉，卡车等最高1600奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: saloon cars pay N500 at each toll point, SUVs and jeeps pay N800, minibuses and light buses pay N1000, while trucks, buses and multi-axle vehicles pay N1,600

key_facts.fact: HURIWA指控部分路段在收费前已出现路面剥落等劣化迹象
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: alleging that sections of the road began showing signs of deterioration, including peeling surfaces, before toll collection commenced
